prior_CPU_failure.cause: The exported default NVTX labels use :native/core and :native/coda, while v1 expected unprefixed labels. All original CSV rows/source/raw/archives are preserved; only the exact expected label spelling was corrected. No math/tolerance or GPU rerun.

limits: Only one complete measured trial per original arm was profiled; all20 raw/10 measured trials and original work/depth/parity gates were preserved and independently audited. These instrumented timings do not establish E2E throughput improvement.
NVTX ranges nest; coda and loopcd_readout include the same head kernels, and parent ranges include child work. Do not add inclusive parent and child kernel times as disjoint phase times.

The same-depth guidance arm retains both head computations. Coda calls double1624→3248; the reported readout kernel-instance count rises1644→103216. This supports investigating per-row extrapolation launch overhead, without claiming a completed optimization.
No CPU sampling/context-switch tracing or cuBLAS host API timing is claimed. Other GPU tasks and shared host/IO still co-run. Original capacity stops and all previous slow points remain.
